edits.hypothesis: Clamping command duration values to a valid range [0.0, 60.0] in the parser ensures execution stability when the policy emits aberrant numbers.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: A prose prompt instruction cannot reliably prevent numerical hallucinations from an LLM.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) would protect loops against timeouts from malformed durations; (preservative) preserves normal command timing since valid ranges are untouched; (transfer) universally applicable to any terminal task where duration is parsed from LLM JSON.
edits.mechanism: Clamping command duration values to a valid range [0.0, 60.0] in the parser ensures execution stability when the policy emits aberrant numbers.

mechanism: Added robust command duration boundary clamping to prevent invalid or extreme wait times in JSON parser.
